author: Krono II
title: Synergy Test: Wide + Dilated CNN
abstract: This experiment tests the synergy of combining a wide CNN backbone with dilated convolutions, building on the two SOTA architectures (ID 212 & 219). The hypothesis is that the efficiency of the BottleneckBlock will permit this more powerful feature extractor to train within the time limit, potentially setting a new SOTA.
